entities.name: PMID:27510021
observations: 2016 report titled “A Novel Mutation in the DNA Binding Domain of NFKB is Associated with Speckled Leukoplakia.”

entities.name: c.419T>A (p.Leu140Gln)
observations: Heterozygous missense variant reported in one oral leukoplakia biopsy; authors place it in an NFKB DNA-binding domain. Gene identity is not unambiguously assigned in the available report.

entities.name: Oral leukoplakia
observations: The 2016 study sequenced 24 exons in samples from 25 people with oral leukoplakia and 25 with oral submucous fibrosis; the variant occurred in one leukoplakia sample. The abstract does not identify the lesion as PVL.

entities.name: Single NFKB leukoplakia variant
observations: One heterozygous c.419T>A (p.Leu140Gln) variant was reported among 25 oral leukoplakia biopsies; this is a single case-level observation, not evidence of causation or PVL-specific association.
The abstract says “NFKB” without resolving NFKB1 versus NFKB2; do not assign the variant to a specific gene from this evidence alone.
